plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
notes: Runtime, journal, adapters, import, reconciliation and the staff console (Network SSO + PKCE, admins listed in BILLING_STAFF_SUBJECTS; cashout approve/deny, review queue, reconciliation, freeze, audit log) are built and tested. The console needs the Network to add https://billing.openvibe.network/auth/callback to client `billing` before anyone can sign in. The Live client is a patch (docs/live-patch.diff, switch BILLING_AUTHORITY off by default) with its cutover sequence in docs/live-cutover.md; the cutover has not been executed, so Live stays authoritative.
